Name: Floral Tappers
Author: sproggen
Description:
12 flowers and mushrooms as tree tappers. Requires "Alternative Textures" to work, use the paintbucket tool on a tree tapper in game to choose whichever texture you like, when placing tappers on trees normally there is a chance one of these will show instead, adding variety to your forest farms!

Map recolour of the ground in images is DaisyNiko's "Earthy Recolour" map mod.

Downloads.Description: Unzip and drag the contents into your Mods folder. Ensure you have the required mod "Alternative Textures"

Manifest.Name: Sprogs Floral Tappers for AT
Manifest.Description: Tapper retextures for use with the Alternative Textures mod
Manifest.Author: Sprog
